rec.name: PDP Product Attributes (Rating Slider Bars)
rec.status: Built — launched (reviewed by team; installation guide rewritten for non-developers in Oct 2025)

what.text: A block on the product page (placed below the add-to-cart / payment icons) that shows a headline such as 'What our customers say', followed by a grey rounded panel with up to 3 attribute rows. Each row has a title (e.g. Quality, Durability, Load capacity), a white horizontal bar with a small dark pill marker positioned by a 0–100 value, and 2 or 3 labels beneath the bar (e.g. 'not good / good / very good' or 'short-lived / long-lasting'). Content is maintained per product through a metaobject linked via a product metafield. Styling is controlled in the theme editor.

why.text: Rating-scale visuals turn product qualities into quick, scannable proof. A marker near the 'very good' end gives an at-a-glance signal of quality, durability and strength. This reduces uncertainty at the moment of purchase and supports the value claim without long copy. Placing it near the CTA keeps reassurance close to the decision point. Because the content is per product, the comparison feels specific rather than generic. Caveat: the scores are self-declared, so credibility depends on honest values.

how.text: 1) In Shopify admin, create a metaobject definition 'CRO | Product Attributes' (type cro_product_attributes). Fields: Name (display name, required), Heading, Title 01–03 (single line text), Progress 01–03 (integer, 0–100), Attributes 01–03 (list of single line text, 2 or 3 labels). 2) Create a product metafield 'CRO | PDP | Product attributes' (standard.cro_product_attributes), type Mixed reference, referencing that metaobject, with storefront access set to Read. 3) Add the snippet ed-cro-product-attributes.liquid, which renders only if the metafield exists. It loops over items 1–3, renders a title only if one is set, and positions the marker with left:calc(progress% - marker width). The marker is 24px wide on desktop and 16px on mobile, so 100 does not overflow the track. A label list with 2 entries is pinned left/right and one with 3 is pinned left/centre/right. 3) Paste the block JSON ('CRO | Product Attributes', limit 1) into the blocks array of the main-product section schema, and render the snippet in that section. 4) Fill in an entry and assign it to each product. Products without the metafield show nothing.

items: Heading: font size (desktop and mobile), letter-spacing, weight 100–900, normal/italic, uppercase toggle, margin-bottom
Title: font size, weight, letter-spacing, normal/italic, uppercase toggle, alignment left/center/right
Attribute label font size (desktop and mobile)
Per-product content via metaobject: heading, up to 3 titles, 0–100 values, and 2–3 labels each

dependencies.text: Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with a main-product section whose schema can accept a block. Requires a metaobject definition and a product metafield of type Mixed reference with storefront Read access. Non-developers cannot add the schema block without help. The code contains a theme-specific class 'hidden-lap-and-up' for the desktop hide option, which may need adapting. The original ticket asked for bold/italic/underline rich text. The built version uses weight and italic selects with no underline, and the marker colour/track colour wording differs slightly. No app is needed.

items: Scroll depth / viewability of the block
Return rate (to check that scores do not over-promise)
